params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: A new sector for drinks (soft drinks, coffee, alcohol, no/low), with its own sources; alcohol is read for 18+ only.

Backlog item from the brief: not for this pass. A new sector in the Standard, with the 18+ rule for alcohol, followed by sources in the Observatory and the filters on the site.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Add a Drinks sector
